name: Imitation Girl
source:
I spend my days cleaning a mansion, alongside an android girl. I’m tired of this life, and I’m tired of the master of the house.

[From [url=https://kirinkoumori.itch.io/imitation-girl]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我每天和一个机器人女孩一起打扫一座豪宅。我厌倦了这样的生活，也厌倦了这个家的主人。

[来自[url=https://kirinkoumori.itch.io/imitation-girl]itch.io[/url]]
